faq.title: Good questions
faq.note: anything else? the feedback button is always in the corner.

free.a: Yes. There are no ads and no payment step: you never enter a card. The free plan covers up to 10 transactions a day.

bank.q: Do I have to connect my bank?
bank.a: No. Trakeo never asks for your bank login. You add transactions yourself, or download a CSV statement from your bank and import it (Beta).

currencies.a: EUR, CZK, USD, GBP, PLN and CHF. You can hold accounts in any of them and move money between them.

rates.q: Which exchange rate does Trakeo use?
rates.a: The one your bank gave you. When you move money between currencies, you enter the rate you actually got, so your balances always match your bank's. Trakeo also keeps the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, as a guide and to estimate your total wealth across all your accounts in one currency.

tracking.a: No. There are no third-party analytics or advertising scripts on Trakeo.

languages.q: Which languages is it available in?
languages.a: English, Español and Čeština. You can switch at any time from the top bar.
